exception_description: I-797A (approval with I-94) generated for petition type that should produce I-797B (approval without I-94); wrong suffix rules.
Receipt number deviates from EAC/WAC/LIN/SRC/NBC + 10-digit format; downstream FOIA and status-check systems reject lookup.
I-797 approval validity period end date calculated as start + duration but fails to account for month-length variation; 1-day error.

exception_title: Notice Addressee vs Attorney of Record
exception_description: I-797 mailed to beneficiary instead of attorney of record per G-28; counsel not notified; response deadline missed.
I-797C RFE notice states 87-day response window; system calculates deadline from mailing date not receipt date; discrepancy.
Machine-readable zone on I-797 card notice misprinted; barcode scanner at port of entry cannot decode; manual override required.
I-797 approval for F-1 extension not transmitted to SEVIS; DSO sees expired record while USCIS shows approval.

exception_title: RFE vs NOID vs NOIR Misclassification
exception_description: LLM classifies Notice of Intent to Deny (NOID) as RFE; different response strategy and legal standard not applied.
System generates two receipt notices for single filing; petitioner pays fee twice believing first notice was lost.
Petition withdrawn by petitioner; approval notice already in mail queue; I-797 approval issued post-withdrawal.

exception_title: Notice Date vs Fiscal Year Audit Trail
exception_description: I-797 notice dated Sep 30 but printed Oct 1; fiscal-year attribution of adjudication differs between notice and internal log.

exception_title: Sensitive PII on I-797 Transport Letter
exception_description: I-797D transport letter contains full SSN in plaintext; document transmitted via non-encrypted channel.
LLM generates generic RFE response checklist; does not tailor to specific deficiency language in I-797C notice.
Multiple companies on shared portal; I-797 approval for company A delivered to company B inbox.

exception_title: Approval Not Written to CLAIMS Before Notice Mailed
exception_description: I-797 approval notice mailed before CLAIMS database updated; applicant calls to check status and system shows pending.
